.st-pipe{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}
.st-pipe div{padding:10px 12px;border-radius:16px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.7);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.st-pipe div.on{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;border-color:var(--ink)}
.st-pipe small{display:block;font-size:11px;opacity:.7}.st-pipe b{font-size:22px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.st-vs{display:grid;gap:14px;margin-top:16px}
.st-rep{padding:14px 16px;border-radius:18px;background:var(--bg2);display:grid;gap:10px;align-content:start}
.st-say{margin:0;font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--ink)}
.st-cnt{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin-top:18px}
.st-cnt b{display:block;font-size:26px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}.st-cnt small{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.st-lead{display:grid;grid-template-columns:28px minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:12px;align-items:center;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:14px}
.st-lead:last-child{border-bottom:0}.st-lead i{font-style:normal;color:var(--faint);font-size:12px}
.st-lead.now{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,122,92,.08),transparent)}
[hidden]{display:none!important}
@media(max-width:700px){.st-cnt{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
/* split + laptop */
.sk-split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.72fr) minmax(0,1.28fr);gap:clamp(28px,5vw,64px);align-items:center}
.sk-split>*{min-width:0}
.sk-split.sk-rev{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr)}
.sk-col{display:grid;gap:28px;min-width:0}
@media(max-width:1000px){.sk-split,.sk-split.sk-rev{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}}
.sk-lap{margin-bottom:22px}
.sk-lap::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:-4%;right:-4%;bottom:-12px;height:12px;border-radius:0 0 16px 16px;background:linear-gradient(#d8d0c8,#b4aaa0)}
.sk-lap .kx-scr{min-height:0}
.sk-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:10px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg2);font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.sk-bar i{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:#FF8F7A}.sk-bar i:nth-child(2){background:#F5C46B}.sk-bar i:nth-child(3){background:#7BD3A2}
.sk-bar span{margin-left:8px}
.sk-lap .ai-panel{border-radius:0;box-shadow:none;padding:20px}
@media(min-width:1100px){.sk-lap .st-vs{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
/* dialer canvas */
.sk-cv{padding:clamp(22px,4vw,48px) clamp(16px,3vw,32px);min-height:0;display:grid;justify-items:center;align-content:start;gap:22px}
.sk-cvh{margin:0;font-size:clamp(20px,2.2vw,26px);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em;text-align:center}
.sk-dp{width:100%;max-width:580px;position:relative;z-index:1}
.sk-co{white-space:normal;max-width:200px;line-height:1.35;align-items:flex-start;z-index:2;color:var(--ink)}
.sk-co svg{flex:none;margin-top:2px}
@media(max-width:1180px){
 .sk-cv{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));justify-items:stretch;gap:12px}
 .sk-cvh{order:-2;grid-column:1/-1}.sk-dp{order:-1;grid-column:1/-1;margin-inline:auto}
 .sk-co{position:static;max-width:none;animation:none}
}
@media(max-width:700px){.sk-cv{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);padding:18px 14px}}
/* objections stage */
.sk-tabw{display:flex;justify-content:center;margin:0 0 28px}
.sk-tabw .kx-tabs button{min-height:44px}
.sk-rk{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--faint);margin-right:8px}
.kx-tabs button.on .sk-rk{color:#c0391f}
.sk-sc{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.25fr) minmax(0,.75fr);gap:clamp(20px,4vw,48px);background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border-radius:28px;padding:clamp(20px,3.4vw,40px);box-shadow:0 40px 80px -40px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.sk-sc>*{min-width:0}
#objections .sk-sc .ai-lbl{color:var(--faint)}
#objections .sk-sc .ai-quote{font-size:clamp(20px,2.4vw,30px);line-height:1.25;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin-bottom:26px}
.sk-play{margin:8px 0 22px;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.55;font-size:16px}
.sk-r{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:12px;border-left:1px solid var(--line);padding-left:clamp(20px,3vw,40px)}
.sk-big{font-size:clamp(64px,9vw,116px);line-height:.95;letter-spacing:-.05em;font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.sk-meter{height:8px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--bg2);overflow:hidden}
.sk-meter i{display:block;height:100%;width:var(--w);background:var(--grad);border-radius:99px;transform-origin:0 50%;animation:skm .9s var(--kx-ease) both}
@keyframes skm{from{transform:scaleX(0)}}
.sk-sub{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.sk-ckr{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:24px;margin-top:34px}
@media(max-width:800px){.sk-sc{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.sk-r{border-left:0;padding-left:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:18px}.sk-ckr{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:12px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.sk-meter i{animation:none}}
/* compare */
.sk-cmp .kx-k{display:block;margin-bottom:6px}
.sk-cmp .before .kx-k{color:#6b645d}
.sk-cmp .after .kx-k{color:rgba(255,255,255,.62)}
.sk-cr{padding:16px 0;border-top:1px solid rgba(120,100,90,.2)}
.sk-cmp .after .sk-cr{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
.sk-cr b{display:block;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:6px;color:var(--ink)}
.sk-cmp .after .sk-cr b{color:#F5C46B}
.sk-cr p{margin:0;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;font-size:15px;line-height:1.5}
.sk-cr svg{flex:none;width:17px;height:17px;margin-top:2px}
.sk-cmp .before .sk-cr svg{color:#8f857c;transform:rotate(45deg)}
.sk-cmp .after .sk-cr svg{color:#7BD3A2}
/* feature plans */
.sk-p{isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden}
.sk-pl .kx-plan.hot{transform:none;translate:0 -10px}
@media(max-width:900px){.sk-pl .kx-plan.hot{translate:none}}
.sk-ph{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.sk-n{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--faint);letter-spacing:.08em}
.sk-p.hot .sk-n{color:rgba(255,255,255,.6)}
.sk-p .kx-h{margin:6px 0 4px}
.sk-p ul{gap:18px}
.sk-p li{padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.sk-p.hot li{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.14)}
.sk-p li b{display:block;font-size:16px;font-weight:600}
.sk-p li small{display:block;margin-top:4px;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;line-height:1.45}
.sk-p.hot li small{color:rgba(255,255,255,.72)}
.sk-p li em{display:inline-block;margin-top:10px;font-style:normal;padding:4px 11px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--chip);font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.sk-p.hot li em{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:rgba(255,255,255,.8)}
/* orbit */
.sk-oc{container-type:inline-size;width:100%;max-width:520px;margin-inline:auto}
.sk-orb{--sk-r:calc(36cqw)}
.sk-chip{font-size:13.5px;padding:8px 14px;font-weight:500}
.sk-orb .kx-core{inset:32%;color:var(--ink);font-size:clamp(14px,4.2cqw,20px);line-height:1.15}
@media(max-width:480px){.sk-chip{font-size:12px;padding:6px 10px}}
@supports not (width:1cqw){.sk-oc{width:300px;max-width:100%}.sk-orb{--sk-r:108px}}
/* swiss */
.sk-sw .kx-row{grid-template-columns:72px minmax(0,.8fr) minmax(0,1.6fr);padding:28px 0;align-items:start}
.sk-sw .kx-idx{color:#c0391f}
.sk-c3{display:grid;gap:12px;min-width:0}
.sk-sw .kx-p{font-size:clamp(16px,1.6vw,19px);color:var(--ink)}
.sk-mm{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted)}
@media(max-width:700px){.sk-sw .kx-row{grid-template-columns:44px minmax(0,1fr);padding:22px 0}}
/* pairs carousel */
.sk-hrow{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:30px}
.sk-hrow .ai-txt{flex:1 1 360px;min-width:0}
.sk-hrow .kx-nav{margin:0}
.sk-pc{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:250px;padding:26px;text-decoration:none;color:#f4ece6}
.sk-pc .kx-h{margin-top:auto;padding-top:34px;color:#fff}
.sk-ex{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-top:18px;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;color:#F5C46B}
.sk-ex svg{width:15px;height:15px;transition:transform .3s var(--kx-ease)}
@media(hover:hover){.sk-pc:hover .sk-ex svg{transform:translateX(4px)}}
.sk-pc:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #F5C46B;outline-offset:3px}
.st-pipe .on b{color:#fff}
#features .kx-card.dark li b,#features li b{color:inherit}
